reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供即时通讯通道接入：将钉钉、QQ 与个人微信聚合到一个网关服务，实现消息转发、会话管理与流式回复。证据来源于 README 的功能说明与安装/配置流程，以及 package.json 中的 dsh 插件声明与 IM 依赖，故判定为外部服务集成类插件，风险主要集中在外部网络通信与凭据管理。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 IM 网关插件，在同一设置入口下接入钉钉、QQ 与个人微信通道，并支持扫码绑定与流式消息回复。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness IM gateway plugin that connects DingTalk, QQ, and personal WeChat channels through one configuration flow, with QR binding and streaming message replies.

capabilities: Bridge messages between multiple IM channels and a DeepSeek Harness agent loop
Perform QR-based binding/credential capture for IM channel setup
Manage IM session-level commands and lifecycle states (e.g., help/model/status/new/reset/stop)
Stream incremental replies to supported IM channels when available
Store and reload gateway channel configuration from settings for runtime use

reasons.code: README states a unified `ctx.imGateway` for DingTalk/QQ/WeChat(iLink) with multi-instance channels, QR binding, slash commands, and streaming replies, indicating core bot gateway behavior.

Package metadata marks this as a dsh bundle plugin with web client injection and dependencies on dingtalk-stream and QQ SDKs plus websocket support, confirming external IM protocol/network integration.
